items: Full Form: National Action for Mechanized Sanitation Ecosystem
Type: Central Sector Scheme
Budget: ₹349 crore (2022–2026)
Ministries Involved: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & Ministry of Social Justice and
Empowerment
Objectives:
o 100% mechanized cleaning of sewers and septic tanks.
o Zero fatalities in sanitation work.
o Formalization, skilling, and empowerment of sanitation workers.
Key Features:
o Covers 500 AMRUT cities.
o Insurance coverage under Ayushman Bharat for sanitation workers.

o Provides training and mechanized equipment for safe cleaning.
o Establishes Emergency Response Sanitation Units (ERSUs).
o Promotes alternative livelihoods and worker rehabilitation.
o Develops a sanitation worker database for effective monitoring.
Focus: Eliminate manual scavenging, ensure worker safety, and promote mechanized sanitation
systems.
